description: This file contains utility function declarations, macro definitions, and includes for internal use within the PyTorch codebase, specifically related to Python interoperability, tensor storage, and type traits.

methods.name: THPUtils_setError
methods.description: Sets an error message with formatted string.

methods.name: THPUtils_invalidArguments
methods.description: Handles invalid arguments for a function, providing details.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkIntTuple
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject is a tuple of integers.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackIntTuple
methods.description: Unpacks a PyObject tuple into a vector of integers.

methods.name: THPUtils_addPyMethodDefs
methods.description: Adds method definitions to a vector for Python C API.

methods.name: THPUtils_getCallable
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject is callable and retrieves it.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackLongs
methods.description: Unpacks a PyObject into a vector of int64_t.

methods.name: setBackCompatBroadcastWarn
methods.description: Sets warning flag for back-compat broadcast.

methods.name: getBackCompatBroadcastWarn
methods.description: Gets warning flag for back-compat broadcast.

methods.name: setBackCompatKeepdimWarn
methods.description: Sets warning flag for back-compat keepdim.

methods.name: getBackCompatKeepdimWarn
methods.description: Gets warning flag for back-compat keepdim.

methods.name: maybeThrowBackCompatKeepdimWarn
methods.description: Potentially throws warning for back-compat keepdim.

methods.name: storage_fill
methods.description: Fills a storage with a specified value.

methods.name: storage_set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific index in storage.

methods.name: storage_get
methods.description: Gets a value from storage at a specific index.

methods.name: uuid_to_string
methods.description: Converts UUID bytes to string representation.
